_comment: Benchmark Gaia DR3 sources with known/published nature. Used by the web tool for verification and demo runs. All source_ids verified by direct Gaia DR3 ADQL query on 2026-05-28.

items.name: Gaia BH1
items.notes: First confirmed dormant BH. RUWE=7.6, NSS=1. RV-confirmed.

items.name: Gaia BH2
items.expected_tier: Demoted by F#30 — but real BH (known cascade trade-off)
items.notes: Real BH confirmed by El-Badry. Cascade DEMOTES (F#30 K-giant) by design — same population as HD 1957. F#30 trades BH2-class real BHs for chromatic FP rejection. RV follow-up was required to settle BH2's classification.

items.name: Gaia BH3
items.notes: 33 M_⊙ BH (heaviest stellar-mass BH). P > Gaia mission baseline, so NSS gives Acceleration not Orbital. Demo: cascade will fail because no NSS Orbital fit.

items.name: 4 UMi
items.notes: BP-RP=1.57, K3-III with strong molecular bands. Photocentric a_phot inflated 2x → M_2 over-estimated 2.9x. Naked-eye Polaris-region giant.

items.name: Phantom-RV A-dwarf
items.notes: rv_chisq_pvalue=0.9989 — RV chi-sq says NO variability, yet rv_amplitude_robust is non-zero due to single-transit outlier. The pattern Filter #31 catches.

items.name: HD 76078
items.notes: Confirmed double-lined SB2 stellar binary. Should fail F#29 if NSS solution type contains SB2 markers (NSS bit 3 set here).

items.name: HD 111232
items.notes: M sin(i)=6.8 M_Jup planet at P=1143 d. Cascade should land in 'planet_candidate' class, not BH/NS.

items.name: HD 81040
items.notes: M sin(i)=6.86 M_Jup planet at P=1001 d. Recovery validates the cascade can correctly land at sub-stellar mass.

groups.label: This work — Tier-1 candidates (clean after re-vet)

items.name: TYC 1363-2339-1
items.notes: Cleanest BH candidate. logg=4.01 ANN, BP-RP=0.56 (F color), zero risk flags.

items.name: TYC 8785-1657-1
items.notes: logg=4.37 ANN dwarf, BP-RP=0.66. Shortest orbital period in catalog (P=491 d).

items.name: TYC 1299-727-1
items.notes: Clean F-subgiant, P=620 d, e=0.55 — high eccentricity hints at natal kick.

items.name: TYC 2773-348-1
items.notes: Mass-gap edge. RUWE=8.04 strong astrometric reflex.

items.name: TYC 4791-2322-1
items.notes: RUWE=17.3 highest in catalog. NSS significance=13 (lowest — needs DR4 re-fit). Excellent RV target.

items.name: HD 207141
items.notes: If real, the heaviest dormant BH in our catalog. R=8 R_⊙ gives single F30 flag. Needs UV check.

items.name: BD+38 2040
items.notes: Has HGCA row (independent confirmation). Flagged for R=6.1 R_⊙ but GSP-Spec ANN logg=3.45 — not K-giant.

items.name: HD 1957
items.ref: This work — K-giant chromatic calibration #2 (after 4 UMi)
items.notes: Strongest single-target case but K-giant evidence cannot be ignored. Was Tier-1 NS at first cascade; demoted by GSP-Spec ANN re-vet. R=15.5 R_⊙, logg=2.63, K spectral class — textbook F#30 territory.
